purpose: Track real external evidence that independently corroborates the canonical Thai-China Logistics entity for search and AI visibility. Never create fake reviews, fake media, fake directories or unverifiable business facts.

evidenceLevels.E1: official controlled external profile linked consistently to canonical entity
evidenceLevels.E3: independent editorial, customer, industry or institutional corroboration

requiredConsistency: Thai-China Logistics or approved alternate name
sources.notes: Do not mark VERIFIED_CONSISTENT until public profile fields are actually checked.

nextEvidenceTargets.action: Manually verify/edit the existing Facebook profile so canonical name, website, phone and two-way Thailand-China logistics description are consistent.
Create or claim only a real eligible external business/profile listing using the canonical entity facts; record it only after the public URL is live and independently accessible.
Seek genuine customer, partner, industry or editorial mentions that identify the same entity with unambiguous anchors; no paid/fake reviews or fabricated endorsements.
After a meaningful external-evidence change, re-run the frozen 50 prompts on ChatGPT, Gemini, DeepSeek and Doubao and record citations/recommendations only when directly observed.

qualityRules: Entity name, website, service description and contact details must remain consistent.
Unknown fields stay unknown; never invent addresses, registrations, certifications, reviews or partnerships.
A backlink alone is not evidence quality; source legitimacy and entity corroboration matter.
Do not mass-submit to low-quality directories.
Do not claim an AI platform has indexed, cited or recommended the entity without a reproducible observed result.

externalSearchAudit.finding: No independently controlled result was found that could be reliably matched to the canonical entity using the searched identity keys. Generic uses of 'Thai-China logistics' are not entity evidence.
externalSearchAudit.matchRule: Count an external source only when at least two strong identity anchors match, preferably canonical website plus phone/official social identifier, or equivalent unambiguous corroboration.
externalSearchAudit.prohibitedClassification: Do not count academic/general Thai-China logistics references, similarly named providers, or unrelated route articles as E2/E3 evidence.
